scripts.dev: node api.js && npx concurrently "npm run start:server" "npm run start:client"
scripts.build: node api.js && cd client && npm run build
scripts.start: node api.js && npm run build && npm run start:server
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install && cd ../ai_service && pip3 install -r requirements.txt
